# Miniature sweep

## Phase 1 — Survey

Read the miniature repository and report what it says.

## Phase 2 — Respond

Answer whatever review is already waiting before starting anything new.

## Phase 3 — Propose

Propose an answer to a question that needs judgement.

## Phase 4 — Work

Choose one item and make its smallest useful increment.

## Rules

- Never invent a source value.
- Never merge.
